original_defect.source: previously processed Job 65 artifact and supplied defect evidence
false_positive_classes: corporate body content after the INDEX
lines without a credible trailing printed-page reference
original_defect.impact: False entries created false section boundaries and contributed to approximately 81% unassigned evidence.

root_cause: TOC detection admitted independently strong pages outside the single physical INDEX block.
Entry extraction retained weak/unparsed lines and lacked a reusable title-quality gate.
Block termination did not stop reliably after consecutive non-entry content.

changes.block_selection: Select the strongest explicit INDEX/CONTENTS seed and expand only through credible adjacent continuation pages.
changes.block_end: Stop entry collection after two consecutive non-entry lines while retaining raw document evidence outside the TOC entry list.
entry_requirements: valid trailing Arabic or Roman printed-page reference
no address, company number, contact/account, date, section-marker, numeric-only, or stop-word-only title

decision: The deterministic TOC boundary and entry-quality hotfix passes fixture and backend regression verification. Reprocess the real Job 65 PDF before claiming a live-document pass.
